description: This file defines classes and functions for handling first-class tensor dimensions in the functorch library, including Dim, Tensor, and related utilities for dimension management, tensor operations, and code introspection.

classes.name: DimList
classes.description: A list of first-class dimensions that can be bound to tensor dimensions, supporting binding, indexing, and representation.

classes.name: DimensionMismatchError
classes.description: Exception raised for dimension mismatch errors.

classes.name: DimensionBindError
classes.description: Exception raised for errors during dimension binding.

classes.name: _Tensor
classes.description: Base class for first-class tensor objects with dimension management and custom tensor operations.

classes.name: Dim
classes.description: Represents a single dimension, either named or positional, with size and batching capabilities.

classes.name: Tensor
classes.description: First-class tensor class with dimension levels, delayed evaluation, and advanced tensor operations.

classes.name: DotPart
classes.description: Helper class for organizing dimensions in dot product operations.

methods.name: dims
methods.description: Creates one or more Dim objects, using bytecode inspection to infer names when possible.

methods.name: dimlists
methods.description: Creates one or more DimList objects, similar to dims but for lists of dimensions.

methods.name: from_positional
methods.description: Creates a Tensor object from a PyTorch tensor with specified dimension levels.

methods.name: create_delayed
methods.description: Creates a delayed tensor that defers computation until needed.

methods.name: expand
methods.description: Expands a tensor by adding or expanding dimensions, supporting first-class Dim objects.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Indexes a tensor using first-class dimensions, binding positional dims to Dim objects.

methods.name: stack
methods.description: Stacks tensors along a new dimension, supporting first-class Dim objects.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a tensor along a dimension, binding split sizes to dimensions.

methods.name: cat
methods.description: Concatenates tensors along a specified dimension, with support for first-class Dim objects.

methods.name: dot
methods.description: Performs a dot product between two tensors along specified dimensions, supporting batching and contraction.

methods.name: index (function)
methods.description: Converts a regular tensor to a first-class tensor by binding specified positional dims.
